svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, written in config.md (question); Literature strategist: the synthesis analysis too; review.md and refs.bib written with its own edits (agent, only when needed); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: the synthesis analysis too; review.md and refs.bib written with its own edits (agent, only when needed); Session: each start's report read (question); Script: every entry's DOI or arXiv ID resolved, one resolve over refs.bib (script); Literature strategist that wrote refs.bib, resumed with the identifier check: titles resolved, strict: a failing identifier corrected or removed (agent, only when needed); Script: every entry resolved again, one resolve over refs.bib (script); You review the sources, optional (stop); Script: each corrected or added entry's DOI or arXiv ID resolved again (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); Formatter: each target other than Markdown, the review's issues back to the strategist that wrote review.md (agent, only when needed).
